finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE:** Ticket titled `fwrd82-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (Ref **RD-1015**, Customer "Bench Test Ltd"), confirmed present in the Repair tickets list.

**Objective 2 — DONE:** Part `fwrd82-n1 RD Part A` added with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$125.00** (ticket total $125.00).

**Objective 3 — DONE:** Part `fwrd82-n1 RD Part B` added with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$250.00** (ticket total $375.00).

**Objective 4 — DONE:** Part A's cost changed from 100 to 150 (markup still 25%). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (ticket total $437.50).

**Objective 5 — DONE:** Ticket ends in status **Ready**. The precondition discovered: the app rejected the first "Mark Ready" attempt with the exact alert — *"Ticket is not ready Part "fwrd82-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier Part "fwrd82-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"* — i.e. **every part on the ticket must have a supplier set** (despite the part form labelling Supplier as optional). I satisfied it by editing each part and setting Supplier to "Bench Supplier Ltd", after which "Mark Ready" succeeded with no error; the page showed Status "Ready" and the action buttons changed to "Mark Draft"/"Mark Closed".

**Objective 6 — DONE:** Both parts deleted (each via an in-page "Delete part" confirm modal); the parts table then read "No parts on this ticket yet." with total $0.00 and 0 parts. Status stayed "Ready" during deletion. Archiving required no preconditions and no confirmation — "Archive ticket" applied immediately, flipping to "Unarchive ticket" and adding an "Archived" badge. Verified inactive: the active list count dropped from "Showing 1–10 of 14" to "Showing 1–10 of 13", RD-1015 is absent from the active rows, and it appears only under "Show archived" as: `RD-1015 fwrd82-n1 RD Bench Ticket Archived Bench Test Ltd Ready 0 2026-09-22`. Nothing created by this run remains active.
